exceptions.reason: The peer has left. MQTT goodbye reason sent to the other device. Preserve the wire value for existing clients.
Failed to handle the hello message. MQTT error.message sent to the device. Preserve the existing error payload.
No valid Authorization header was provided. HTTP 401 error text in authenticateRequest; keep the public API response unchanged.
Invalid authorization token. HTTP 401 error text in authenticateRequest; keep the public API response unchanged.
Authorization validation failed. HTTP 401 catch-path response; keep the public API response unchanged.
Device is not connected. HTTP 500 command-dispatch response; management clients consume the error field.
Invalid command type. HTTP 500 command-dispatch response; preserve the command API payload.
clientIds must be an array. HTTP 400 device-status response. Preserve clientIds as the request key and the existing error text.
Missing required parameters: caller_mac, target_mac. HTTP 400 call-request response. Preserve parameter identifiers and response bytes.
The other device is offline; try again later. Call result with status offline. The Java management client forwards message to the caller's tool result, so keep its Chinese language behavior.

[device_call] You have an incoming call from <caller_nickname or unknown>. Would you like to answer? The Chinese fallback means unknown. The prefix is a parsed command marker. The Python listener strips [device_call] and sends the remaining text to STT/TTS; retain the entire Chinese speech template and its fallback.
Missing required parameter: mac. HTTP 400 call-accept response. Preserve the mac key and existing error payload.
Already in a call. requestCall returns this message with status error. The HTTP call API serializes it and Java forwards it as a user-facing tool result.
There is no pending call. joinCall returns this message with status no_pending. The HTTP API forwards the result, so retain the public/localized message.
The caller has left or the call has timed out. joinCall returns this message with status caller_gone. Preserve the response consumed by server-side calling tools.
